title: Worksheet eval harness (internal, no UI)
description: Add a nightly evaluation harness that runs 50 canonical UK National Curriculum + GCSE prompts through aiGenerateWorksheet, applies runWorksheetPostValidators, and writes a structured eval-report.json artefact. Provides regression protection against silent quality drift when prompts, models, or validators change.
rationale: Quality is the single attribute that cannot recover from an outage. An eval harness lets Phase B and Phase C land confidently — every PR can run `pnpm eval:worksheets` locally and CI can gate on regression. No product code changes; pure infra.
steps: - 50 fixtures spanning: 10 maths (Y3, Y6, Y7, Y9, Y10, Y11), 10 English, 10 science, 10 humanities, 10 SEND-specific (dyslexia, dyscalculia, autism, ADHD, EAL).

- runner.ts — iterates fixtures, calls aiGenerateWorksheet, applies runWorksheetPostValidators, scores against `rules`, writes eval-report.json with per-fixture { passed, failedRules[], warnings[], generationMs, costUsd }.

- rules.ts — small registry mapping rule name → predicate (most rules already exist as post-validator behaviours; this is just an assertion layer that reads worksheet + postValidatorWarnings and decides pass/fail).
Add a pnpm script: `"eval:worksheets": "tsx server/tests/worksheet-eval/runner.ts"`. Add a `--bail` flag for CI.

Add a GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/worksheet-eval.yml that runs nightly (cron '0 3 * * *') and on demand (workflow_dispatch). Uploads eval-report.json as an artefact. Does NOT block PRs — that comes later when we have a baseline.

Add a small Markdown summariser that reads eval-report.json and prints a one-screen pass/fail table to stdout. CI calls this in the job summary so failures are visible without downloading the artefact.
Cost guard: the runner aborts if estimated cost (params.length * tokensPerRun * pricePerToken) exceeds $1.00. Budget configurable via env `EVAL_BUDGET_USD`.
Add docs/eval-harness.md (one page) explaining: how to add a fixture, what the rules mean, how to interpret the report.
Do NOT introduce eval as a PR-blocking gate yet — that requires a stable baseline (target: PR-7 in Phase B once symbolic-maths verification has settled the maths quality).
do_not_touch: Any product code under client/src/ except importing from it read-only
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm eval:worksheets` runs all 50 fixtures locally and writes server/tests/worksheet-eval/eval-report.json.
Cost guard aborts cleanly if estimated cost exceeds budget.
GitHub Actions workflow runs nightly and uploads the artefact.
Job summary shows a per-rule pass/fail table.
Adding a new fixture is a one-file change documented in docs/eval-harness.md.
verification: pnpm eval:worksheets (with EVAL_BUDGET_USD=0.01 — should abort cleanly)
pnpm eval:worksheets (with full budget — should produce a report)
Trigger workflow_dispatch on the new GitHub Actions workflow

size_estimate.notes: 50 of those files are tiny JSON fixtures (~5 lines each).

context_budget_for_fresh_chat: LOW. The agent only needs to read worksheetPostValidator.ts (608 lines) once, plus aiGenerateWorksheet's parameter shape from generate.ts. Fixtures are written from a small template.
